commands: docker run --rm python:3.12 sh -c "git clone --depth 1 -b fast-track https://github.com/jishusharma/mts.git /w && cd /w && pip install -q pytest numpy pandas tzdata && time python -m pytest MyTradingSys/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider"
docker run --rm -v ${PWD}:/w -w /w python:3.12 sh -c "pip install -q pytest numpy pandas tzdata && time python -m pytest MyTradingSys/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider"
done_when: The audit file has wall-clock numbers for Windows native, Docker Linux FS and Docker bind mount on the same commit, at least 2 runs each for the first two, with test pass/fail counts per variant and a one-line recommendation backed by the ratio.
goal: Decide with numbers whether the MTS test suite should run in Docker/WSL (Linux filesystem) instead of native Windows. Operator 2026-10-22: Windows process start-up makes scripts and tests slow; NB has Docker.
note: Laptop DESKTOP-F7IU69N has no WSL/Docker (operator installs it as admin). Results decide whether gates move to WSL/Docker on every machine.
scope_in: JIS-NB only; Defender exclusions applied first (scripts/operator/defender_exclusions.ps1 -Check = 0 missing)
Same commit of origin/fast-track both ways
Docker: official python image matching ci.yml's Python version; repo cloned INSIDE the container/Linux FS (not a bind mount of C:), pip install pytest numpy pandas tzdata as ci.yml
Also time the bind-mount variant once (repo on C: mounted into the container) to show the cost of crossing filesystems
scope_out: No changes to ci.yml, run_all_tests.py or any hook
No live tree, no deploy, no processes stopped
steps: git -C <fresh worktree> rev-parse HEAD; record it
Windows: time `python scripts/dev/run_all_tests.py --quick` 2x and `python -m pytest MyTradingSys/tests -q -x -p no:cacheprovider` 2x; record wall seconds and pass/fail counts

Docker (Linux FS): docker run --rm python:<ver> sh -c 'git clone --depth 1 -b fast-track <repo url> /w && cd /w && pip install -q pytest numpy pandas tzdata && time python -m pytest MyTradingSys/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider'; 2x; also run_all_tests.py --quick if it runs on Linux
Docker bind mount: same pytest command with -v <worktree>:/w; 1x
Also time `python -c pass` x20 on each side (start-up floor)

Write MyTradingSys/research/audits/docker_vs_windows_2026-10-22.md: table (variant, wall s, tests passed/failed/skipped, start-up ms), commit SHA, machine load at the time, and which tests fail only on Linux
tests: Measurement card: no new tests. Numbers must come from the runs on NB this card made; quote the raw `time` lines.
title: Measure MTS test suite in Docker (Linux FS) vs native Windows on JIS-NB
